trigger.request_payload: QIF v0.7.1 Outcome Collection Ledgerを実装・検証・公開する。実運用の結果観測をappend-only revisionsとして保持し、late-arriving outcomes、source corrections、custody history、supersessionを記録する。既存のprospective enrollmentを上書きせず、欠測・除外・訂正を品質や真実と誤認せず、複数領域で使えるdomain-general構造にする。

outcome_reports.note: QIF v0.7.1 implements append-only outcome revisions, source corrections, custody history, late-arrival handling, current-snapshot alignment, governance routing, 21 negative fixtures, documentation, and portable packaging. npm test passed 16/16 positive and 1238/1238 negative checks; AOF organization verification passed 295/295. Public release pending.

gaps.summary: The underlying need is not specific enough yet.
The intended direction is not yet explicit.
Key constraints, scope, and current conditions are missing.
Forbidden changes or non-negotiables are not explicit.

asked_questions: Which service touchpoint or environment should this redesign cover, and what should stay out of scope?
How should improvement success be judged: which metric or end state matters most?

user_answers.question: Which service touchpoint or environment should this redesign cover, and what should stay out of scope?
user_answers.answer: 対象はcalibration-report packageのschema、local verifier、example、negative fixtures、docs、roadmap、portable package、release。外部データ収集、UI、外部システム統合、実運用判断、既存のprospective enrollmentや過去revisionの破壊的更新は対象外。

user_answers.question: How should improvement success be judged: which metric or end state matters most?
user_answers.answer: 成功は、観測revisionの連続性とsupersession、late-arrival、source correction、custody event、最新snapshot整合、governance routingを再現可能に検証し、実データなしやexample-onlyを真実と誤認せず、npm test・portable・AOF組織検証・公開releaseを完了すること。
